about: East St. Paul is a rural municipality immediately northeast of Winnipeg, Manitoba, along the Red River—not the City of Winnipeg and not a downtown neighbourhood. Suburban lots, river lots, and remaining countryside form a separate municipal government on the capital’s edge. About 10,000 people live in East St. Paul RM.
